source_name: Fio banka – Zprávy z burzy (broker commentary on issuer announcements)
why_relevant: Czech broker desk that summarises PSE issuer announcements within hours, including AGM outcomes and supervisory-board elections at Moneta and KB. Fast, Czech-language tripwire; interpretation must be verified against the filing.

source_name: Časopis Bankovnictví – coverage of Czech bank AGM and board decisions
why_relevant: Trade magazine that reliably reports Czech bank AGM outcomes and supervisory-board/audit-committee elections in Czech, sometimes naming individuals not highlighted in the issuer's own headline.

source_name: Portál občana / gov.cz – service description: Oznámení emitenta o vyřazení CP z regulovaného trhu
why_relevant: Documents the formal notification pathway for delisting decisions — a strong precursor of ownership/organisational restructuring (e.g. squeeze-out of a listed Czech bank), and names the responsible authority and forms to monitor.

source_name: PSE – Konsolidovaná výroční zpráva BCPP (exchange annual report)
why_relevant: Gives the authoritative annual list of issuers admitted to the Prime/Standard markets — the population definition needed to enumerate which banking/payment issuers this cell must monitor, and it also documents the exchange's own governance/disclosure infrastructure.

source_name: Česká bankovní asociace (ČBA) — Komise a pracovní skupiny
why_relevant: ČBA committees and working groups are staffed by delegated specialists and chaired by senior managers of member banks; the roster is effectively a map of who owns payments, cards, compliance, digitalisation and HR agendas inside each Czech bank, and changes to it signal internal reorganisation and leadership moves.

source_name: Česká bankovní asociace — seznam členů (member list)
why_relevant: ČBA full membership covers ~34-37 banks and building societies representing >99% of the Czech banking sector; the member list is the canonical actor directory a scout should watch for jobs/leadership monitoring, and additions/exits themselves signal market entries and exits.

source_name: ČBA — prezidium a dozorčí výbor (association leadership announcements)
why_relevant: ČBA presidium seats are held ex officio by bank CEOs (recent reporting: Aleš Blažek/ČSOB as president, Michal Strcula/Air Bank, Jan Juchelka/KB, Jakub Dusílek, Igor Vida; Tomáš Nidetzký/Národní rozvojová banka chairing the supervisory committee). Elections to these bodies are a near-real-time leaderboard of who currently runs each bank.

source_name: Sdružení pro bankovní karty ČR (SBK) — činnost a členové
why_relevant: The closest Czech equivalent of a payments association: an interest grouping of banks and card-industry organisations (reported ~18 regular members plus ~23 observers) coordinating card/payment development. Its member+observer list is a directory of acquirers, processors, terminal and ATM players — exactly the actor set for payments hiring and org-change monitoring.

source_name: Česká fintech asociace / Czech Fintech Association (ČEFTAS) — members
why_relevant: Reported 50-80+ members spanning payment institutions, investment platforms, crypto/digital-asset firms, banks and investors (AKCENTA, GoPay, Twisto, ComGate, Adyen, Home Credit, Centrální depozitář cenných papírů, Banking Circle among names in press). Best single directory of non-bank payments actors in CZ; chairman reported as Miroslav Lukeš with Ondřej Machač as executive manager.

source_name: Česká leasingová a finanční asociace (ČLFA) — Orgány ČLFA
why_relevant: Publishes the named board (reported: chair Jana Hanušová; vice-chairs Jakub Stárek, Josef Vajsejtl; members Pavel Fořt, Luděk Jírů, Josef Langmayer, Pavel Nejman) — i.e. current senior executives of consumer-credit and leasing firms. Board elections are announced and picked up by trade press, giving dated leadership-move events.

source_name: ČLFA — seznam členských společností (39 members)
why_relevant: Directory of ~39 leasing / consumer-credit / non-bank finance companies operating in CZ — the actor set adjacent to banking that also hires payments, risk and collections staff. A third-party mirror on Finance.cz makes the list easy to snapshot.

source_name: Asociace pro kapitálový trh ČR (AKAT) — vedení a členové
why_relevant: Reported 100+ members (domestic investment companies, foreign fund managers, service providers) and elected leadership (chair reported as Jaromír Sladkovský as of June 2026; executive-director role reported variously as Jana Michalíková / historically Jana Brodani — must be re-verified). Both the directory and the elections are people-intelligence for asset-management arms of banks.

source_name: AmCham Czech Republic — Finance Committee
why_relevant: AmCham's Finance Committee convenes senior finance/banking executives of member firms; committee chairs are named senior people and committee output identifies which banks are engaging on which policy topics. English-language, so cheap to parse.

source_name: AmCham Czech Republic — Board of Directors
why_relevant: The AmCham board seats named country CEOs and managing directors, historically including banking/financial-services figures; board turnover is a leading indicator of country-manager changes.

source_name: AmCham Czech Republic — Membership Directory (Corporate)
why_relevant: Corporate directory listing member companies with profile pages; a cross-sector actor list that includes banks, payment firms and their vendors, useful for building the watch-list beyond pure financial associations.

source_name: AmCham Czech Republic — EU Transparency Register / LobbyFacts datacard
why_relevant: Transparency-register filings disclose the chamber's declared staff, lobbyist headcount, budget and named representatives — an independent, structured cross-check on chamber personnel that the chamber's own site may not publish.

source_name: SPIR — Sdružení pro internetový rozvoj: předsednictvo a členové
why_relevant: SPIR publishes its executive board with named people and employers (reported: Michal Hanák/MAFRA re-elected chair from 16 June 2026; vice-chairs Michal Feix/Seznam.cz and Martin Picek/WPP Media). Relevant to A5 mainly as a digital-economy adjacency and as a template for board-diff monitoring; membership includes the tech/media firms banks buy from.

source_name: ICT UNIE — Orgány ICT UNIE
why_relevant: ICT Unie's board (statutory body of up to 11 members, president plus two vice-presidents heading steering committees) and its member list cover the IT/integration vendors that build and staff Czech banking and payments systems — a source of vendor-side leadership moves and of which vendors sit closest to bank IT.

source_name: Česká kryptoměnová asociace (ČKMA)
why_relevant: Self-organising body for the Czech crypto/digital-asset industry (chair reported as František Vinopal; founding members include Confirmo/Coinmate, General Bytes, Simple Coin, Bitcomp). As MiCA-era crypto firms professionalise and hire compliance and payments staff, this is the directory of that actor set.

source_name: Svaz průmyslu a dopravy ČR (SP ČR) — odvětvové svazy / členská základna
why_relevant: The confederation's sectoral-association registry is a pointer-of-pointers: it lists ČBA, Česká fintech asociace and peer bodies with contact and profile pages, letting a scout enumerate financial-sector associations exhaustively rather than guessing names.

source_name: Spolkový rejstřík / justice.cz — association filings (statutární orgán)
why_relevant: Czech associations are registered legal persons; the public register records their statutory bodies with full names, birth dates and dated appointment/termination entries. This is the authoritative, dated cross-check on who chairs ČBA, ČEFTAS (IČO 05320534), ČLFA, AKAT (IČO 65399501) or SPIR (IČO 70108005) — and it timestamps changes that association websites publish late or not at all.

source_name: Association LinkedIn company pages (Czech Fintech Association, ČKMA, AmCham CZ)
why_relevant: Association pages surface event speakers, new-member announcements and staff, and the 'people' tab exposes who lists the association among their roles — a live people-graph layered on top of the static member directory.

source_name: Fondinfo.cz / opojisteni.cz / finance.cz association aggregator directories
why_relevant: Czech financial portals maintain curated lists of professional associations and their members; they are easier to scrape than some association sites and act as a fallback mirror when a primary site is JS-rendered or unreachable.

source_name: ČBA event/conference and education programme pages (speaker rosters)
why_relevant: Association conferences and expert panels publish speaker lists with exact job titles and employers — often the fastest public confirmation that someone has taken a new senior role at a Czech bank, and a signal of which functions each bank is currently investing in.
